supersession_reason: V73 V1 payload parts do not reconstruct to their recorded compressed SHA-256 and are therefore not usable authority. V74 rebuilds the same intended calibration class directly from authenticated frozen inputs and records fresh digests.
sampling_frame: FOUNDATION_CORPUS_DISCOVERY_V1_20260824 frozen 50k sample; fit104-aware population metadata, pathology-blind calibration authority

definitions.rna_library_size: authenticated raw source_library from frozen sample operator metadata
definitions.rna_detected_feature_count: CSR row NNZ in authenticated 50k x 41,238 log1p10k expression matrix; values themselves are not exported
definitions.rna_zero_fraction: 1 - detected_feature_count / measured_scalar_addresses for the matched matrix_id/operator; structural missing and collision-unresolved addresses are excluded from the measured denominator
definitions.log1p_library_vs_detected_pearson: within-operator aggregate dependence summary from the frozen sample

row_alignment_evidence.rule: expression CSR row i is frozen sample CSV row i
row_alignment_evidence.audit_check: for all 35 operators present in FOUNDATION_DISCOVERY_EXPRESSION_AUDIT.json, both sample cell count and summed CSR row NNZ reproduce the audit exactly
row_alignment_evidence.remaining_seven_nph52: matched by stable matrix_id and stable_key metadata; numeric operator indices are not used across the old/new ordering boundary
